1	#!/bin/sh
2	# .fleet-gate.sh — fleet gate for the #70 beamr >=0.19.2 migration, box-scoped.
3	#
4	# THE FORMER EXCLUSION IS THE PROOF. Every prior gate on this box excluded the
5	# gleam-runtime populations under #64 (validator refuses gleam-1.18.1/OTP-27
6	# beams). beamr >=0.19.2 carries the validator fix, so this gate runs the FULL
7	# workspace suite with NO exclusions: runtime_codecs going green on this box's
8	# own mix is the migration's proof, measured where the refusal lived.
9	# HOME can be EMPTY in the workflow gate context (learned 2026-08-18: fleet-53
10	# round 1-3 red on "cargo not found on PATH (/.cargo/bin:...)"). Absolute box
11	# path first; $HOME fallback kept for other hosts.
12	PATH="/home/aion/.cargo/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
13	export PATH
14	# cargo itself resolves ~/.cargo and ~/.rustup through HOME — default it too.
15	if [ -z "${HOME:-}" ]; then HOME=/home/aion; export HOME; fi
16	# Concurrent flights exhaust the 1024-fd soft limit (EMFILE reds, 2026-08-18);
17	# the hard limit is 524288 — raise within it so contention cannot fake a red.
18	ulimit -n 65536 2>/dev/null || true
19	
20	if ! command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
21	    echo "FAIL: cargo not found on PATH ($PATH)" >&2
22	    exit 1
23	fi
24	
25	set -e
26	
27	# Leg 1 — LOCK WITNESS (a patch/req is witnessed at the lock, never the line):
28	# the resolved graph must contain zero beamr rows below 0.19.2.
29	bad=$(grep -A1 '^name = "beamr"' Cargo.lock | grep '^version' | grep -Ev 'version = "0\.(19\.([2-9]|[1-9][0-9])|[2-9][0-9]*\.)' || true)
30	if [ -n "$bad" ]; then
31	    echo "FAIL: pre-0.19.2 beamr in the resolved lock:"; echo "$bad"; exit 1
32	fi
33	echo "gate leg 1 ok: lock witness clean (all beamr rows >=0.19.2)"
34	
35	# Leg 2 — full workspace tests, NO gleam exclusions. This includes
36	# runtime_codecs (28 tests) on this box's gleam-1.18.1/OTP-27 mix.
37	cargo test --workspace
38	
39	# Leg 3 — workspace lint wall.
40	cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# regen-awl-sdk-closure.sh — DEV-TIME regeneration of the embedded AWL SDK
3	# BEAM closure. Requires a LOCAL gleam toolchain (unless --harvest-only).
4	#
5	# What it does:
6	#   1. Runs `gleam build` in the oracle Gleam project (default:
7	#      examples/awl-hello) so build/dev/erlang is fresh. Pass --harvest-only
8	#      to skip the build and harvest an existing built tree instead
9	#      (refused when the tree is older than manifest.toml — a dependency
10	#      bump without a rebuild must not stamp a new version on stale beams).
11	#   2. Computes the production dependency closure TRANSITIVELY — seeded from
12	#      gleam.toml [dependencies], expanded over manifest.toml requirements,
13	#      mirroring production_closure() in
14	#      crates/aion-package/src/project/discover.rs — and copies those
15	#      packages' BEAMs into crates/aion-awl-package/sdk-closure/, excluding the
16	#      SDK test-only modules (aion_flow_ffi, aion@testing, aion@testing@*)
17	#      exactly as the legacy discovery filter does. No package list is
18	#      hard-coded: a new transitive dependency of aion_flow is picked up by
19	#      the next regeneration automatically.
20	#   3. Regenerates crates/aion-awl-package/src/bundle_data.rs: a sorted
21	#      include_bytes! table plus the aion_flow version stamp read from the
22	#      oracle project's manifest.toml lockfile.
23	#
24	# When to run: whenever gleam/aion_flow (or its gleam_json / gleam_stdlib
25	# pins) changes. Commit the regenerated sdk-closure/ tree and bundle_data.rs
26	# together — bundle-integrity tests pin the closure checksum and will fail
27	# until the pin is updated deliberately.
28	#
29	# The PRODUCT path never invokes this script, and no build.rs does: the
30	# committed closure ships embedded in the compiled binary via include_bytes!.
31	set -euo pipefail
32	
33	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
34	PROJECT="$REPO_ROOT/examples/awl-hello"
35	HARVEST_ONLY=0
36	
37	while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
38	  case "$1" in
39	    --harvest-only) HARVEST_ONLY=1 ;;
40	    --from)
41	      shift
42	      PROJECT="$1"
43	      ;;
44	    *)
45	      echo "usage: $0 [--harvest-only] [--from <gleam project root>]" >&2
46	      exit 2
47	      ;;
48	  esac
49	  shift
50	done
51	
52	ERLANG="$PROJECT/build/dev/erlang"
53	CLOSURE_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/crates/aion-awl-package/sdk-closure"
54	GENERATED="$REPO_ROOT/crates/aion-awl-package/src/bundle_data.rs"
55	
56	if [ "$HARVEST_ONLY" -eq 0 ]; then
57	  (cd "$PROJECT" && gleam build)
58	elif [ ! -d "$ERLANG" ]; then
59	  echo "error: --harvest-only but $ERLANG does not exist" >&2
60	  exit 1
61	elif [ -z "$(find "$ERLANG" -name '*.beam' -newer "$PROJECT/manifest.toml" -print | head -n 1)" ]; then
62	  # A dependency bump refreshes manifest.toml; harvesting a tree built
63	  # BEFORE that refresh would stamp the new version over stale beams.
64	  echo "error: --harvest-only but every .beam under $ERLANG is older than" >&2
65	  echo "       $PROJECT/manifest.toml — run gleam build first (stale harvest refused)" >&2
66	  exit 1
67	fi
68	
69	SDK_VERSION="$(sed -n 's/.*name = "aion_flow", version = "\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "$PROJECT/manifest.toml" | head -1)"
70	if [ -z "$SDK_VERSION" ]; then
71	  echo "error: could not read aion_flow version from $PROJECT/manifest.toml" >&2
72	  exit 1
73	fi
74	
75	# --- production dependency closure, computed transitively -------------------
76	# Seeds: the oracle project's gleam.toml [dependencies] (production only —
77	# dev-dependencies never enter). Expansion: manifest.toml `requirements`
78	# lists, followed to a fixed point. This mirrors production_closure() in
79	# crates/aion-package/src/project/discover.rs so the embedded bundle can
80	# never silently lag a new transitive SDK dependency.
81	production_dep_seeds() {
82	  awk '
83	    /^\[dependencies\]$/ { in_deps = 1; next }
84	    /^\[/ { in_deps = 0 }
85	    in_deps && /^[a-z0-9_]+[ \t]*=/ {
86	      name = $0
87	      sub(/[ \t]*=.*/, "", name)
88	      print name
89	    }
90	  ' "$PROJECT/gleam.toml"
91	}
92	
93	requirements_of() {
94	  sed -n "s/.*{ name = \"$1\",.*requirements = \[\([^]]*\)\].*/\1/p" \
95	    "$PROJECT/manifest.toml" | head -1 | tr -d '",'
96	}
97	
98	PACKAGES=""
99	QUEUE="$(production_dep_seeds | tr '\n' ' ')"
100	while [ -n "${QUEUE// /}" ]; do
101	  # shellcheck disable=SC2086
102	  set -- $QUEUE
103	  pkg="$1"
104	  shift
105	  QUEUE="$*"
106	  case " $PACKAGES " in *" $pkg "*) continue ;; esac
107	  if ! grep -q "{ name = \"$pkg\"," "$PROJECT/manifest.toml"; then
108	    echo "error: dependency $pkg has no manifest.toml entry (unresolved lockfile?)" >&2
109	    exit 1
110	  fi
111	  PACKAGES="$PACKAGES $pkg"
112	  QUEUE="$QUEUE $(requirements_of "$pkg")"
113	done
114	PACKAGES="$(printf '%s\n' $PACKAGES | LC_ALL=C sort | tr '\n' ' ')"
115	
116	case " $PACKAGES " in
117	  *" aion_flow "*) ;;
118	  *)
119	    echo "error: aion_flow is not in the oracle project's production closure" >&2
120	    exit 1
121	    ;;
122	esac
123	echo "production closure:$PACKAGES" | tr -s ' '
124	
125	excluded() {
126	  case "$1" in
127	    aion_flow_ffi | aion@testing | aion@testing@*) return 0 ;;
128	    *) return 1 ;;
129	  esac
130	}
131	
132	rm -rf "$CLOSURE_DIR"
133	ROWS=""
134	# shellcheck disable=SC2086
135	for package in $PACKAGES; do
136	  ebin="$ERLANG/$package/ebin"
137	  if [ ! -d "$ebin" ]; then
138	    echo "error: missing $ebin (is the project built?)" >&2
139	    exit 1
140	  fi
141	  mkdir -p "$CLOSURE_DIR/$package"
142	  for beam in "$ebin"/*.beam; do
143	    module="$(basename "$beam" .beam)"
144	    if [ "$package" = aion_flow ] && excluded "$module"; then
145	      continue
146	    fi
147	    cp "$beam" "$CLOSURE_DIR/$package/$module.beam"
148	    ROWS="$ROWS$module\t$package\n"
149	  done
150	done
151	
152	{
153	  echo "//! GENERATED by scripts/regen-awl-sdk-closure.sh — DO NOT EDIT BY HAND."
154	  echo "//!"
155	  echo "//! Embedded AWL SDK BEAM closure: the oracle project's production"
156	  echo "//! dependency closure, computed transitively from \`gleam.toml\` +"
157	  echo "//! \`manifest.toml\` ($(echo "$PACKAGES" | tr -s ' ' | sed 's/^ //;s/ $//;s/ /, /g;s/[a-z_][a-z_0-9]*/\`&\`/g')),"
158	  echo "//! SDK test-only modules excluded, harvested from a built Gleam tree."
159	  echo "//! Regenerate with the script above whenever the SDK changes."
160	  echo
161	  echo "/// \`aion_flow\` version the embedded closure was built from."
162	  echo "pub(crate) const SDK_CLOSURE_VERSION: &str = \"$SDK_VERSION\";"
163	  echo

165	  echo "pub(crate) const MODULES: &[(&str, &[u8])] = &["
